headline: Rigetti Cepheus-1-108Q generally available; Novera QPU sold to University of Saskatchewan
details: Cepheus-1-108Q: 108 qubits (12 x 9-qubit chiplets interconnected), 99.1% median 2Q gate fidelity, ~60ns gate speed. Available on Rigetti QCS and Amazon Braket. Also: Rigetti sold 9-qubit Novera QPU to University of Saskatchewan (Canada's first university-owned open-architecture quantum computer).
relevance_reason: 108q superconducting with 99.1% 2Q fidelity is below Quantinuum Helios (99.921%) for our precision experiments. Chiplet architecture limits connectivity vs. trapped-ion. Useful for circuit depth testing.
access_path: Rigetti QCS direct access. Amazon Braket. 99.1% 2Q fidelity is usable for shallow MERA circuits.
